# 環境 windows × 勾選 all

## 選單
zsh              zsh、自動建議／跳目錄／語法上色外掛,並改成預設 shell（裝不了：Windows 的 shell 是 PowerShell，補全、語法上色內建，跳目錄的 zoxide 每台 Windows 都裝）
starship         提示列：顯示目錄、git 狀態、時間，跨 shell 共用一份設定 [mise]
eza              彩色、帶圖示的 ls(ll、la、lt 用它) [mise]
fzf              模糊搜尋:Ctrl-R 找歷史、Ctrl-T 找檔案 [mise]
bat              有語法上色的 cat [mise]
ripgrep          rg:比 grep 快的全文搜尋 [mise]
vim              終端機文字編輯器 [mise]
fastfetch        終端機印出系統資訊 [mise]
btop             終端機看 CPU、記憶體、行程（裝不了：btop 的 release 只有 Linux 版，改勾 bottom）
bottom           btm:跨 OS 的終端機資源監控(CPU、記憶體、行程),Windows 也能用 [mise]
earlyoom         記憶體快滿先砍最肥的程序；ssh、tailscale、ssm-agent 保有記憶體和 CPU（裝不了：earlyoom 與記憶體、CPU 的保護都靠 Linux 的 systemd，只裝在 Linux）
gh               GitHub CLI(官方 apt 源),裝完 gh auth login [mise]
code-server      瀏覽器開的 VS Code（裝不了：code-server 官方不出 Windows 版，到 WSL 裝）
tailscale        私人 VPN,連自己的機器 [winget]
openssh-server   sshd:讓別台 ssh 進這台(WSL 改聽 2222,避開 Windows 的 22)（裝不了：Windows 內建 OpenSSH Server，啟用要系統管理員權限）
cloudflared      Cloudflare Tunnel:把服務開給 tailnet 外的人 [mise]
herdr            終端機多工,同時開多個 coding agent [mise]
ttyd             把終端機開成網頁,ttyd-serve 用 [mise]
wakatime         wakatime-cli:把寫程式的時間送到 WakaTime(有勾的 agent 與 code-server 一併裝 plugin;會一併裝 Node) [script]
claude           Claude Code CLI [official]
codex            Codex CLI [official]
opencode         OpenCode CLI(會一併裝 Node) [mise]
ffmpeg           影音轉檔、抽音軌與影格 [mise]
uv               Python 套件與專案管理(uv run、uv tool run;要的 Python 由 uv 自己下載;勾了 snapserver、agent-config 也會自動裝) [mise]
snapserver       Snapcast 朗讀串流服務:agent 的回覆唸到個人電腦,voice-out on、off 開關(會一併裝 ffmpeg、uv)（裝不了：snapserver 沒有 Windows 版，朗讀服務放跑 agent 的 Linux 主機）
snapclient       Snapcast 的 CLI 播放端:在個人電腦收聽已配置主機的朗讀串流 [mise]
node             Node LTS（Linux、macOS、Windows 用 mise 裝，Termux 用 pkg；勾了 playwright-cli、opencode、wakatime 也會自動裝） [mise]
codegraph        程式碼索引給 agent 查(mise 裝官方 release) [mise]
headless-chrome  沒有畫面的 Chrome,給 agent 開網頁 [winget]
playwright-cli   agent 操作瀏覽器(開本機 Chrome,或 attach 遠端瀏覽器,會一併裝 Node) [mise]
agent-config     skillshare:統一管理 agent 的 skills、MCP、全域規則(agent-config repo,會一併裝 uv) [official]
windows-mcp      讓 agent 操作 Windows 桌面(截圖、點擊、打字)的 MCP server,只在 Windows 主機裝(mise 裝,會一併裝 uv) [mise]

## init 存下的設定
[data]
    codeServerPassword = "x"
    codexLbApiKey = "x"
    context7ApiKey = ""
    graphifyApiKey = ""
    discordBotToken = ""
    wakatimeApiKey = ""
    homeRepo = "~/code"
    machineUse = "custom"
    tools = ["zsh", "starship", "eza", "fzf", "bat", "ripgrep", "vim", "fastfetch", "btop", "bottom", "earlyoom", "gh", "code-server", "tailscale", "openssh-server", "cloudflared", "herdr", "ttyd", "wakatime", "claude", "codex", "opencode", "ffmpeg", "uv", "snapserver", "snapclient", "node", "codegraph", "headless-chrome", "playwright-cli", "agent-config", "windows-mcp"]
    toolsSchema = 3

    # 個人 Codex 使用的非秘密模型資料。
    [data.aiPersonal]
    codexModel = ""

[interpreters.ps1]
    command = "powershell"
    args = ["-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File"]

## 要裝
starship eza fzf bat ripgrep vim fastfetch bottom gh tailscale cloudflared herdr ttyd wakatime claude codex opencode ffmpeg uv snapclient node codegraph headless-chrome playwright-cli agent-config windows-mcp

## 略過(裝不了)
zsh btop earlyoom code-server openssh-server snapserver

## 套件清單
apt/pkg: 
brew: 
brew cask: 
winget: jdx.mise Microsoft.PowerShell Microsoft.WindowsTerminal Git.Git Google.Chrome.EXE Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64 Tailscale.Tailscale

## mise 清單
# chezmoi 照選裝工具的勾選產生(home/dot_config/mise/conf.d/dotfiles.toml.tmpl),別直接改,下次 apply 會蓋掉。
# 自己要加的工具用 `mise use -g <工具>`,寫在 ~/.config/mise/config.toml,不會跟這份打架。
# 誰走 mise 見 home/.chezmoidata/tool-table.yaml;run_onchange_after_install-mise 在這份變了之後跑 mise install。
[tools]
"zoxide" = "latest"
"bat" = "latest"
"bottom" = "latest"
"poppler" = "latest"
"cloudflared" = "latest"
"codegraph" = "latest"
"eza" = "latest"
"fastfetch" = "latest"
"ffmpeg" = "latest"
"fzf" = "latest"
"gh" = "latest"
"herdr" = "latest"
"node" = "lts"
"npm:opencode-ai" = { version = "latest", allow_builds = ["opencode-ai"] }
"npm:@playwright/cli" = "latest"
"ripgrep" = "latest"
"github:badaix/snapcast" = { version = "latest", asset_pattern = "snapclient_win64.zip", filter_bins = "snapclient.exe" }
"starship" = "latest"
"ttyd" = "latest"
"uv" = "latest"
"vim" = "latest"
"pipx:windows-mcp" = "latest"

# 專案只放 .nvmrc、.node-version 也照它切 node 版本(預設是空的,只認 mise.toml;#386,
# https://mise.jdx.dev/configuration/settings.html#idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools)。
# pnpm 照專案 package.json 的 packageManager 由 mise 裝、切版本,不靠 Corepack(Node 25 起不附;
# https://mise.jdx.dev/lang/node.html#package-manager-versions-in-package-json)。
# 不開 python:Python 版本交給 uv(讀 .python-version、requires-python),mise 只裝 uv。
[settings]
idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools = ["node", "pnpm"]

### .chezmoiscripts/run_after_zz-install-failed-summary.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$f = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles\install-failed'
if ((Test-Path $f) -and (Get-Item $f).Length -gt 0) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host (T 'PT0g6YCZ5qyh6KOd5aSx5pWXLOS7peS4i+W3sueVpemBjijpjK/oqqToqIrmga/lnKjkuIrpnaI75YW26aSY54Wn5bi46KOd5aW9LOS/ruWlveWOn+WboOW+jOWGjSBjaGV6bW9pIGFwcGx5IOacg+mHjeippik6')
    [IO.File]::ReadAllLines($f, [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }
}
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $f
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-agent-config.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$retrying = $false
$retry_key = 'install-agent-config'
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $HOME ".local\state\dotfiles\retry\$retry_key")

function skip_fail([string]$what, [string]$fix) {
    if (-not $retry_key) { throw 'skip_fail: include ps1-retry first' }
    Write-Host ((T '55Wl6YGOIHswfSjpgJnmrKHoo53lpLHmlZcs6Yyv6Kqk6KiK5oGv5Zyo5LiK6Z2iKTp7MX0=') -f $what, $fix)
    $d = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'retry') | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $d 'install-failed'), "- ${what}:${fix}`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    New-Item -ItemType File -Force (Join-Path $d "retry\$retry_key") | Out-Null
}

$dir = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'skillshare'
$remote = if ($env:AGENT_CONFIG_REMOTE) { $env:AGENT_CONFIG_REMOTE } else { 'https://github.com/henry5720/agent-config.git' }
$ss = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\skillshare\skillshare.exe'
$manual = "skillshare init --git-root root --remote $remote --no-copy --no-skill --no-targets; skillshare install -g; skillshare sync --all"
if ((Test-Path (Join-Path $dir '.git')) -and -not $retrying) {
    Write-Host ((T 'YWdlbnQtY29uZmlnIOW3suWuieijnSh7MH0pLOi3s+mBjuOAguabtOaWsDpza2lsbHNoYXJlIHB1bGw7IHNraWxsc2hhcmUgc3luYyAtLWFsbA==') -f $dir)
    exit 0
}

$env:Path = $env:Path + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')
if (-not (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    skip_fail 'agent-config' ((T 'c2tpbGxzaGFyZSDopoEgZ2l0LOmAmeWPsOaJvuS4jeWIsCh3aW5nZXQg6YCZ5qyh5rKS6KOd5aW9IEdpdC5HaXQpLOS4i+asoSBjaGV6bW9pIGFwcGx5IOacg+mHjeippizmiJYgd2luZ2V0IGluc3RhbGwgLS1pZCBHaXQuR2l0IC0tZXhhY3Qg5LmL5b6M6ZaL5paw55qEIHNoZWxsIOi3kTp7MH0=') -f $manual)
    exit 0
}

if (-not (Test-Path $ss)) {
    $installer = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName() + '.ps1')
    try {
        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runkids/skillshare/main/install.ps1' -OutFile $installer -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
        & $installer
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } catch {
        Write-Host $_
        $code = 1
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -Force $installer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    if (-not (Test-Path $ss)) {
        skip_fail 'agent-config' ((T 'c2tpbGxzaGFyZSDnmoTlrpjmlrkgaW5zdGFsbGVyIOaykui3keWujCzkuIvmrKEgY2hlem1vaSBhcHBseSDmnIPph43oqaYs5oiW6Ieq5bex6LeRIGlybSB7MH0gfCBpZXgs5YaN6ZaL5paw55qEIHNoZWxsIOi3kTp7MX0=') -f 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runkids/skillshare/main/install.ps1', $manual)
        exit 0
    }
}

if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'config.yaml'))) {
    skip_fail 'agent-config' ((T '5om+5LiN5YiwIHswfSzmspLmnIkgaW5pdDvkuIvmrKEgY2hlem1vaSBhcHBseSDmnIPph43oqaY=') -f (Join-Path $dir 'config.yaml'))
    exit 0
}
function Invoke-Skillshare {
    & $ss @args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        skip_fail 'agent-config' ((T 'c2tpbGxzaGFyZSB7MH0g5aSx5pWXKOmMr+iqpOWcqOS4iumdoiks5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6KmmLOaIluiHquW3sei3kTp7MX0=') -f $args[0], $manual)
        exit 0
    }
}
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir '.git'))) { Invoke-Skillshare init --git-root root --remote $remote --no-copy --no-skill --no-targets }
Invoke-Skillshare install -g
Invoke-Skillshare sync --all
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-mise.ps1.tmpl
# mise list (~/.config/mise/conf.d/dotfiles.toml):
#   "zoxide" = "latest"
#   "bat" = "latest"
#   "bottom" = "latest"
#   "poppler" = "latest"
#   "cloudflared" = "latest"
#   "codegraph" = "latest"
#   "eza" = "latest"
#   "fastfetch" = "latest"
#   "ffmpeg" = "latest"
#   "fzf" = "latest"
#   "gh" = "latest"
#   "herdr" = "latest"
#   "node" = "lts"
#   "npm:opencode-ai" = { version = "latest", allow_builds = ["opencode-ai"] }
#   "npm:@playwright/cli" = "latest"
#   "ripgrep" = "latest"
#   "github:badaix/snapcast" = { version = "latest", asset_pattern = "snapclient_win64.zip", filter_bins = "snapclient.exe" }
#   "starship" = "latest"
#   "ttyd" = "latest"
#   "uv" = "latest"
#   "vim" = "latest"
#   "pipx:windows-mcp" = "latest"
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$retrying = $false
$retry_key = 'install-mise'
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $HOME ".local\state\dotfiles\retry\$retry_key")

function skip_fail([string]$what, [string]$fix) {
    if (-not $retry_key) { throw 'skip_fail: include ps1-retry first' }
    Write-Host ((T '55Wl6YGOIHswfSjpgJnmrKHoo53lpLHmlZcs6Yyv6Kqk6KiK5oGv5Zyo5LiK6Z2iKTp7MX0=') -f $what, $fix)
    $d = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'retry') | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $d 'install-failed'), "- ${what}:${fix}`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    New-Item -ItemType File -Force (Join-Path $d "retry\$retry_key") | Out-Null
}

$env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')

if (-not (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    skip_fail (T 'bWlzZSDoiIflroPnmoTlt6Xlhbc=') (T '5om+5LiN5YiwIG1pc2Uod2luZ2V0IOmAmeasoeS5n+aykuijneWlvSks5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6KmmLOaIluWFiCB3aW5nZXQgaW5zdGFsbCAtLWlkIGpkeC5taXNlIC0tZXhhY3Q=')
    exit 0
}

$shims = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'mise\shims'
$parts = @((Get-Item -LiteralPath 'HKCU:\Environment').GetValue('Path', '', 'DoNotExpandEnvironmentNames') -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
if (@($parts | ForEach-Object { [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($_).TrimEnd('\') }) -notcontains $shims) {
    Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKCU:\Environment' -Name Path -Type ExpandString -Value ((@($shims) + $parts) -join ';')
    Write-Host ((T '5bey5oqKIHswfSDliqDliLDkvb/nlKjogIUgUGF0aCDmnIDliY3pnaIo5paw6ZaL55qEIGNtZOOAgXNzaCDmiY3oroDlvpfliLAp') -f $shims)
}

mise install
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    skip_fail (T 'bWlzZSDnmoTlt6Xlhbc=') (T 'bWlzZSBpbnN0YWxsIOacieW3peWFt+aykuijneWlvSjooqsgR2l0SHViIEFQSSDpmZDmtYHmmYLoqK0gR0lUSFVCX1RPS0VOKSzkuIvmrKEgY2hlem1vaSBhcHBseSDmnIPph43oqaYs5oiW6Ieq5bex6LeRIG1pc2UgaW5zdGFsbA==')
}

mise prune --yes
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    skip_fail 'mise prune' (T '5rKS6LeR5a6MLOWPlua2iOWLvumBuOeahOW3peWFt+WPr+iDvemChOeVmeiRlyBzaGltLOS4i+asoSBjaGV6bW9pIGFwcGx5IOacg+mHjeippizmiJboh6rlt7Hot5EgbWlzZSBwcnVuZQ==')
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-official.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$retrying = $false
$retry_key = 'install-official'
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $HOME ".local\state\dotfiles\retry\$retry_key")

function skip_fail([string]$what, [string]$fix) {
    if (-not $retry_key) { throw 'skip_fail: include ps1-retry first' }
    Write-Host ((T '55Wl6YGOIHswfSjpgJnmrKHoo53lpLHmlZcs6Yyv6Kqk6KiK5oGv5Zyo5LiK6Z2iKTp7MX0=') -f $what, $fix)
    $d = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'retry') | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $d 'install-failed'), "- ${what}:${fix}`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    New-Item -ItemType File -Force (Join-Path $d "retry\$retry_key") | Out-Null
}


# claude
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin\claude.exe')) {
    Write-Host ((T 'ezB9IOW3suWuieijnSzot7PpgY4=') -f 'claude')
} else {
    $installer = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName() + '.ps1')
    try {
        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://claude.ai/install.ps1' -OutFile $installer -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
        & $installer
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } catch {
        Write-Host $_
        $code = 1
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -Force $installer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    if ($code -ne 0) {
        skip_fail 'claude' ((T '5a6Y5pa5IGluc3RhbGxlciDmspLot5Hlrows5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6KmmLOaIluiHquW3sei3kTppcm0gezB9IHwgaWV4') -f 'https://claude.ai/install.ps1')
    }
}

# codex
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\OpenAI\Codex\bin\codex.exe')) {
    Write-Host ((T 'ezB9IOW3suWuieijnSzot7PpgY4=') -f 'codex')
} else {
    $installer = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName() + '.ps1')
    try {
        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1' -OutFile $installer -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        $env:CODEX_NON_INTERACTIVE = '1'
        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
        & $installer
        $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    } catch {
        Write-Host $_
        $code = 1
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -Force $installer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
    if ($code -ne 0) {
        skip_fail 'codex' ((T '5a6Y5pa5IGluc3RhbGxlciDmspLot5Hlrows5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6KmmLOaIluiHquW3sei3kTppcm0gezB9IHwgaWV4') -f 'https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1')
    }
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_install-wakatime.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$retrying = $false
$retry_key = 'install-wakatime'
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $HOME ".local\state\dotfiles\retry\$retry_key")

function skip_fail([string]$what, [string]$fix) {
    if (-not $retry_key) { throw 'skip_fail: include ps1-retry first' }
    Write-Host ((T '55Wl6YGOIHswfSjpgJnmrKHoo53lpLHmlZcs6Yyv6Kqk6KiK5oGv5Zyo5LiK6Z2iKTp7MX0=') -f $what, $fix)
    $d = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'retry') | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $d 'install-failed'), "- ${what}:${fix}`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    New-Item -ItemType File -Force (Join-Path $d "retry\$retry_key") | Out-Null
}

$dir = Join-Path $HOME '.wakatime'
$bin = Join-Path $dir 'wakatime-cli-windows-amd64.exe'
if (Test-Path $bin) {
    Write-Host (T 'd2FrYXRpbWUtY2xpIOW3suWuieijnSzot7PpgY4=')
} else {
    $url = 'https://github.com/wakatime/wakatime-cli/releases/latest/download/wakatime-cli-windows-amd64.zip'
    $tmp = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ([IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName())
    try {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
        [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp 'wakatime.zip') -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
        Expand-Archive -Path (Join-Path $tmp 'wakatime.zip') -DestinationPath $tmp -Force -ErrorAction Stop
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
        Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $tmp 'wakatime-cli-windows-amd64.exe') -Destination $bin -ErrorAction Stop
    } catch {
        Write-Host $_
        skip_fail 'wakatime-cli' ((T '5b6eIEdpdEh1YiByZWxlYXNlIOS4i+i8ieaIluino+Wjk+WkseaVlyzkuIvmrKEgY2hlem1vaSBhcHBseSDmnIPph43oqaYs5oiW6Ieq5bex5LiL6LyJIHswfSDop6PplovliLAgezF9') -f $url, $dir)
    } finally {
        Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}
$alias = Join-Path $dir 'wakatime-cli.exe'
if ((Test-Path $bin) -and -not (Test-Path $alias)) {
    Copy-Item -Path $bin -Destination $alias -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

$env:Path = $env:Path + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User')
function Find-Agent([string]$name, [string]$official) {
    $c = Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($c) { return $c.Source }
    return $official
}
function Get-PluginList([string]$exe) {
    try { return (& $exe plugin list --json | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json) } catch { return $null }
}

$claude = Find-Agent 'claude' (Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin\claude.exe')
if (-not (Test-Path $claude)) {
    skip_fail (T 'Q2xhdWRlIENvZGUg55qEIFdha2FUaW1lIHBsdWdpbg==') (T '5om+5LiN5YiwIGNsYXVkZSjlroPpgJnmrKHkuZ/mspLoo53lpb0pLOS4i+asoSBjaGV6bW9pIGFwcGx5IOacg+mHjeippg==')
} elseif (@(Get-PluginList $claude | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'claude-code-wakatime@wakatime' }).Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host (T 'Q2xhdWRlIENvZGUg55qEIFdha2FUaW1lIHBsdWdpbiDlt7Llronoo50s6Lez6YGO')
} else {
    & $claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/wakatime/claude-code-wakatime.git
    & $claude plugin install claude-code-wakatime@wakatime
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        skip_fail (T 'Q2xhdWRlIENvZGUg55qEIFdha2FUaW1lIHBsdWdpbg==') (T 'Y2xhdWRlIHBsdWdpbiDmjIfku6TlpLHmlZcs5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6KmmLOaIluiHquW3sei3kTpjbGF1ZGUgcGx1Z2luIG1hcmtldHBsYWNlIGFkZCBodHRwczovL2dpdGh1Yi5jb20vd2FrYXRpbWUvY2xhdWRlLWNvZGUtd2FrYXRpbWUuZ2l0OyBjbGF1ZGUgcGx1Z2luIGluc3RhbGwgY2xhdWRlLWNvZGUtd2FrYXRpbWVAd2FrYXRpbWU=')
    }
}

$codex = Find-Agent 'codex' (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\OpenAI\Codex\bin\codex.exe')
if (-not (Test-Path $codex)) {
    skip_fail (T 'Q29kZXggQ0xJIOeahCBXYWthVGltZSBwbHVnaW4=') (T '5om+5LiN5YiwIGNvZGV4KOWug+mAmeasoeS5n+aykuijneWlvSks5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6Kmm')
} elseif (@((Get-PluginList $codex).installed | Where-Object { $_.pluginId -eq 'codex-cli-wakatime@wakatime' }).Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host (T 'Q29kZXggQ0xJIOeahCBXYWthVGltZSBwbHVnaW4g5bey5a6J6KOdLOi3s+mBjg==')
} else {
    & $codex plugin marketplace add wakatime/codex-cli-wakatime
    & $codex plugin add codex-cli-wakatime@wakatime
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        skip_fail (T 'Q29kZXggQ0xJIOeahCBXYWthVGltZSBwbHVnaW4=') (T 'Y29kZXggcGx1Z2luIOaMh+S7pOWkseaVlyzkuIvmrKEgY2hlem1vaSBhcHBseSDmnIPph43oqaYs5oiW6Ieq5bex6LeROmNvZGV4IHBsdWdpbiBtYXJrZXRwbGFjZSBhZGQgd2FrYXRpbWUvY29kZXgtY2xpLXdha2F0aW1lOyBjb2RleCBwbHVnaW4gYWRkIGNvZGV4LWNsaS13YWthdGltZUB3YWthdGltZQ==')
    }
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_register-herdr-server.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$herdr = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'mise\shims\herdr.exe'
$user = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name
try {
    $action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'conhost.exe' -Argument ('--headless "{0}" server' -f $herdr) -WorkingDirectory $HOME
    $trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User $user
    $principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $user -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited
    $settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -ExecutionTimeLimit ([TimeSpan]::Zero) -MultipleInstances IgnoreNew -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries
    Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'herdr-server' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
    $sid = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
    $svc = New-Object -ComObject Schedule.Service
    $svc.Connect()
    $svc.GetFolder('\').GetTask('herdr-server').SetSecurityDescriptor("D:(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)(A;;FA;;;$sid)", 0)
    Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'herdr-server' -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-Host (T 'aGVyZHIgc2VydmVyIOaUueeUseeZu+WFpeaZgueahOaOkueoiyBoZXJkci1zZXJ2ZXIg6LW3KOS4gOiIrOasiumZkCk=')
} catch {
    Write-Host ((T 'aGVyZHItc2VydmVyIOaOkueoi+iou+WGiuWkseaVlzp7MH3jgILmraXpqZ/oposgZG9jcy90b29scy9oZXJkci5tZA==') -f $_.Exception.Message)
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_sync-skillshare.ps1.tmpl
# hash: 74b09b2f8729ec45c21a16f6a758161398ea3f2b8c1bc9a46cc48ee76182b810
# pinned: fbf70241bdd22fdcb9b28bca395118e1e96520474b2458fdefdaccd052b76e0b
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$retrying = $false
$retry_key = 'sync-skillshare'
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $HOME ".local\state\dotfiles\retry\$retry_key")

function skip_fail([string]$what, [string]$fix) {
    if (-not $retry_key) { throw 'skip_fail: include ps1-retry first' }
    Write-Host ((T '55Wl6YGOIHswfSjpgJnmrKHoo53lpLHmlZcs6Yyv6Kqk6KiK5oGv5Zyo5LiK6Z2iKTp7MX0=') -f $what, $fix)
    $d = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'retry') | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $d 'install-failed'), "- ${what}:${fix}`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    New-Item -ItemType File -Force (Join-Path $d "retry\$retry_key") | Out-Null
}

$ss = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\skillshare\skillshare.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'skillshare\.git')) -or -not (Test-Path $ss)) {
    Write-Host (T 'YWdlbnQtY29uZmlnIOmChOaykuijneWlvSzot7PpgY4gc2tpbGxzaGFyZSBzeW5j')
    exit 0
}
& $ss sync --all
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    skip_fail 'skillshare sync --all' (T '5aSx5pWXKOmMr+iqpOWcqOS4iumdoiks5LiL5qyhIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6KmmLOaIluiHquW3seWGjei3keS4gOasoQ==')
}
exit 0

### .chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_before_install-packages-windows.ps1.tmpl
$env:PSModulePath = (($env:PSModulePath -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '\\PowerShell\\|\\Microsoft\.PowerShell_' }) -join ';'
function T([string]$b64) { [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($b64)) }

$retrying = $false
$retry_key = 'install-packages-windows'
Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $HOME ".local\state\dotfiles\retry\$retry_key")

function skip_fail([string]$what, [string]$fix) {
    if (-not $retry_key) { throw 'skip_fail: include ps1-retry first' }
    Write-Host ((T '55Wl6YGOIHswfSjpgJnmrKHoo53lpLHmlZcs6Yyv6Kqk6KiK5oGv5Zyo5LiK6Z2iKTp7MX0=') -f $what, $fix)
    $d = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state\dotfiles'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $d 'retry') | Out-Null
    [IO.File]::AppendAllText((Join-Path $d 'install-failed'), "- ${what}:${fix}`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    New-Item -ItemType File -Force (Join-Path $d "retry\$retry_key") | Out-Null
}

$ids = @(
    'jdx.mise',
    'Microsoft.PowerShell',
    'Microsoft.WindowsTerminal',
    'Git.Git',
    'Google.Chrome.EXE',
    'Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64',
    'Tailscale.Tailscale'
)
$alsoAs = @{
    'Google.Chrome.EXE' = @('Google.Chrome')
}

if (-not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    skip_fail ($ids -join ', ') (T '5om+5LiN5YiwIHdpbmdldOOAguW+niBNaWNyb3NvZnQgU3RvcmUg6KOd44CM5oeJ55So56iL5byP5a6J6KOd56iL5byP44CNKEFwcCBJbnN0YWxsZXIp5b6M5YaNIGNoZXptb2kgYXBwbHkg5pyD6YeN6Kmm')
    exit 0
}

foreach ($id in $ids) {
    $installed = $false
    foreach ($name in @($id) + @($alsoAs[$id] | Where-Object { $_ })) {
        winget list --id $name --exact --accept-source-agreements *> $null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $installed = $true; break }
    }
    if ($installed) { continue }
    winget install --id $id --exact --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --disable-interactivity
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        skip_fail $id ((T 'd2luZ2V0IGluc3RhbGwg5aSx5pWXLOS4i+asoSBjaGV6bW9pIGFwcGx5IOacg+mHjeippizmiJboh6rlt7Hot5E6d2luZ2V0IGluc3RhbGwgLS1pZCB7MH0gLS1leGFjdA==') -f $id)
    }
}
exit 0
